```{r}
as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(
      replace(
        x,
        is.na(x),
        FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(
      !is.na(x) &
        x != 0
    )
  }

  tolower(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  ) %in%
    c(
      "true",
      "t",
      "1",
      "yes",
      "y"
    )
}


canonical_contrast <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      "_"
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "_+",
      "_"
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_remove_all(
      "^_|_$"
    )
}


canonical_gene <- function(x) {
  toupper(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  )
}


find_column <- function(
    data,
    candidates,
    description
) {
  found <- candidates[
    candidates %in%
      names(data)
  ]

  if (length(found) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not identify ",
      description,
      ". Available columns: ",
      paste(
        names(data),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  found[1]
}


flatten_list_columns <- function(data) {
  list_columns <- names(data)[
    vapply(
      data,
      is.list,
      logical(1)
    )
  ]

  if (length(list_columns) == 0) {
    return(data)
  }

  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(
          list_columns
        ),
        ~ vapply(
          .x,
          function(value) {
            if (
              is.null(value) ||
              length(value) == 0
            ) {
              return("")
            }

            paste(
              unlist(
                value,
                recursive = TRUE,
                use.names = FALSE
              ),
              collapse = "; "
            )
          },
          character(1)
        )
      )
    )
}


safe_unique_collapse <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- x[
    !is.na(x) &
      nzchar(x)
  ]

  paste(
    sort(
      unique(x)
    ),
    collapse = "; "
  )
}


make_logFC_bin <- function(logFC) {
  factor(
    dplyr::case_when(
      abs(logFC) < 0.5 ~
        "< 0.5",

      abs(logFC) < 1 ~
        "0.5 – 1",

      abs(logFC) < 2 ~
        "1 – 2",

      abs(logFC) < 3 ~
        "2 – 3",

      TRUE ~
        "≥ 3"
    ),
    levels =
      logFC_bin_levels
  )
}
```

```{r}
read_primary_de <- function(
    file,
    molecule,
    dataset
) {
  identifier <- if (
    molecule == "mRNA"
  ) {
    "Gene"
  } else {
    "pre_miRNA"
  }

  data <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(
      identifier
    ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  required_columns <- c(
    "logFC",
    "PValue",
    "FDR"
  )

  if (
    !all(
      required_columns %in%
        names(data)
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      "Expected logFC, PValue and FDR in ",
      file
    )
  }

  data[[identifier]] <- trimws(
    as.character(
      data[[identifier]]
    )
  )

  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Dataset =
        dataset,

      Contrast =
        params$contrast,

      logFC =
        as.numeric(logFC),

      PValue =
        as.numeric(PValue),

      FDR =
        as.numeric(FDR),

      .before =
        1
    )
}


read_stability <- function(
    file,
    molecule,
    flag_column
) {
  data <- read.csv(
    file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  identifier_candidates <- if (
    molecule == "mRNA"
  ) {
    c(
      "Gene",
      "gene",
      "gene_symbol",
      "symbol",
      "GeneSymbol",
      "X",
      "...1"
    )
  } else {
    c(
      "pre_miRNA",
      "pre_mirna",
      "miRNA",
      "mirna",
      "Gene",
      "X",
      "...1"
    )
  }

  identifier <- if (
    molecule == "mRNA"
  ) {
    "Gene"
  } else {
    "pre_miRNA"
  }

  identifier_column <- find_column(
    data,
    identifier_candidates,
    paste0(
      molecule,
      " identifier"
    )
  )

  names(data)[
    names(data) ==
      identifier_column
  ] <- identifier

  contrast_column <- find_column(
    data,
    c(
      "Contrast",
      "contrast",
      "Comparison",
      "comparison"
    ),
    "contrast"
  )

  names(data)[
    names(data) ==
      contrast_column
  ] <- "Contrast"

  if (
    !flag_column %in%
      names(data)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Could not find stability column ",
      flag_column,
      " in ",
      file
    )
  }

  data[[identifier]] <- trimws(
    as.character(
      data[[identifier]]
    )
  )

  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Contrast =
        canonical_contrast(
          Contrast
        ),

      selected_stability_flag =
        as_flag(
          .data[[
            flag_column
          ]]
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast ==
        canonical_contrast(
          params$contrast
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(
        identifier
      ),
      Contrast,
      selected_stability_flag
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}


build_analysis_table <- function(
    dataset,
    molecule,
    primary_file,
    stability_file,
    flag_column
) {
  identifier <- if (
    molecule == "mRNA"
  ) {
    "Gene"
  } else {
    "pre_miRNA"
  }

  primary <- read_primary_de(
    primary_file,
    molecule,
    dataset
  )

  stability <- read_stability(
    stability_file,
    molecule,
    flag_column
  )

  joined <- primary %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      stability,
      by = c(
        identifier,
        "Contrast"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      bootstrap_stable =
        dplyr::coalesce(
          selected_stability_flag,
          FALSE
        ),

      primary_significant =
        !is.na(FDR) &
        FDR <=
          params$fdr_cutoff,

      validated_significant =
        primary_significant &
        bootstrap_stable,

      Direction =
        dplyr::case_when(
          logFC > 0 ~
            "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

          logFC < 0 ~
            "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

          TRUE ~
            NA_character_
        )
    )

  list(
    all =
      joined,

    validated =
      joined %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        validated_significant
      )
  )
}
```

```{r}
analysis_data <- list()

for (
  dataset_name in c(
    "CRC",
    "UCEC"
  )
) {
  files <- input_files[[
    dataset_name
  ]]

  analysis_data[[
    dataset_name
  ]] <- list(
    mRNA =
      build_analysis_table(
        dataset_name,
        "mRNA",
        files$mRNA_primary,
        files$mRNA_stability,
        params$mrna_stability_flag_column
      ),

    pre_miRNA =
      build_analysis_table(
        dataset_name,
        "pre_miRNA",
        files$pre_miRNA_primary,
        files$pre_miRNA_stability,
        params$mirna_stability_flag_column
      )
  )
}
```

```{r}
premir_to_mature_candidates <- function(
    pre_mirnas
) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      unique(
        pre_mirnas
      ),
      function(pre_miRNA) {
        base <- pre_miRNA %>%
          stringr::str_replace(
            "^hsa-mir",
            "hsa-miR"
          )

        candidates <- if (
          stringr::str_detect(
            base,
            "-(5p|3p)$"
          )
        ) {
          base
        } else {
          c(
            paste0(
              base,
              "-5p"
            ),
            paste0(
              base,
              "-3p"
            )
          )
        }

        tibble::tibble(
          pre_miRNA =
            pre_miRNA,

          mature_query =
            candidates
        )
      }
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}


shared_mature_candidates <- premir_to_mature_candidates(
  shared_mirna$
    pre_miRNA
)

write.csv(
  shared_mature_candidates,
  file.path(
    multimir_dir,
    "shared_pre_miRNA_mature_candidates.csv"
  ),
  row.names =
    FALSE
)
```

```{r}
safe_get_multimir <- function(
    pre_miRNA,
    mature_query
) {
  message(
    "Querying: ",
    mature_query
  )

  result <- tryCatch(
    multiMiR::get_multimir(
      mirna =
        mature_query,

      table =
        params$multimir_table,

      summary =
        TRUE
    ),

    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "Failed: ",
        mature_query,
        " | ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )

      NULL
    }
  )

  if (
    is.null(result) ||
    is.null(result@data) ||
    nrow(result@data) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  result@data %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pre_miRNA =
        pre_miRNA,

      mature_query =
        mature_query,

      .before =
        1
    )
}


multimir_cache <- file.path(
  multimir_dir,
  "validated_multiMiR_shared_pre_miRNAs.csv"
)

if (
  file.exists(
    multimir_cache
  ) &&
  !params$
    force_multimir_query
) {
  mir_gene_raw <- read.csv(
    multimir_cache,
    check.names =
      FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

} else {
  if (
    !params$
      run_multimir
  ) {
    stop(
      "multiMiR cache is absent and run_multimir is FALSE."
    )
  }

  mir_gene_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      seq_len(
        nrow(
          shared_mature_candidates
        )
      ),
      function(i) {
        safe_get_multimir(
          shared_mature_candidates$
            pre_miRNA[
              i
            ],

          shared_mature_candidates$
            mature_query[
              i
            ]
        )
      }
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    flatten_list_columns(
      mir_gene_raw
    ),
    multimir_cache,
    row.names =
      FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
mir_gene_df <- mir_gene_raw %>%

          pre_miRNA

        as.character(
          mature_mirna_id

    target_symbol =
      trimws(

          target_symbol

      ),

    target_key =

    experiment =

    support_type =

          params$
```

```{r}
prepare_panel_data <- function(
    dataset_name,
    pathway_name
) {
  pathway_gene_symbols <- hallmark_genes %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gs_name ==
        pathway_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      gene_symbol
    ) %>%
    unique()

  pathway_genes <- analysis_data[[
    dataset_name
  ]]$
    mRNA$
    all %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(
        FDR
      ),

      FDR <=
        params$
          fdr_cutoff,

      bootstrap_stable,

      Gene %in%
        pathway_gene_symbols
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene =
        trimws(
          as.character(
            Gene
          )
        ),

      gene_key =
        canonical_gene(
          Gene
        ),

      logFC =
        as.numeric(
          logFC
        ),

      FDR =
        as.numeric(
          FDR
        ),

      Direction
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      gene,
      .keep_all =
        TRUE
    )

  if (
    dataset_name ==
      "CRC"
  ) {
    dataset_mirna <- shared_mirna %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        pre_miRNA,

        miRNA_logFC =
          CRC_miRNA_logFC,

        miRNA_FDR =
          CRC_miRNA_FDR,

        miRNA_Direction =
          CRC_miRNA_Direction
      )
  } else {
    dataset_mirna <- shared_mirna %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        pre_miRNA,

        miRNA_logFC =
          UCEC_miRNA_logFC,

        miRNA_FDR =
          UCEC_miRNA_FDR,

        miRNA_Direction =
          UCEC_miRNA_Direction
      )
  }

  candidate_interactions <- mir_gene_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      pre_miRNA %in%
        dataset_mirna$
          pre_miRNA,

      target_key %in%
        pathway_genes$
          gene_key
    ) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      dataset_mirna,
      by =
        "pre_miRNA"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      pathway_genes %>%
        dplyr::select(
          gene,
          gene_key
        ),
      by = c(
        "target_key" =
          "gene_key"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  list(
    pathway_genes =
      pathway_genes,

    dataset_mirna =
      dataset_mirna,

    candidate_interactions =
      candidate_interactions
  )
}
```

```{r}
make_outer_ring_layout <- function(
    nodes,
    ppi_edges,
    mirna_gene_edges
) {
  gene_nodes <- nodes %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      node_type ==
        "Gene"
    )

  mirna_nodes <- nodes %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      node_type ==
        "pre-miRNA"
    )

  gene_graph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    ppi_edges %>%
      dplyr::select(
        from,
        to
      ),

    directed =
      FALSE,

    vertices =
      data.frame(
        name =
          gene_nodes$
            name,

        stringsAsFactors =
          FALSE
      )
  )

  set.seed(
    20260807
  )

  set.seed(20260807)

  if (
    igraph::vcount(gene_graph) == 1
  ) {

    xy <- matrix(
      c(0, 0),
      nrow = 1
    )

  } else if (
    igraph::ecount(gene_graph) > 0
  ) {

    xy <- graphlayouts::layout_with_stress(
      gene_graph
    )

  } else {

    xy <- igraph::layout_in_circle(
      gene_graph
    )
  }

  xy <- igraph::norm_coords(
    xy,
    xmin = -1.45,
    xmax =  1.45,
    ymin = -1.30,
    ymax =  1.30
  )

  gene_layout <- tibble::tibble(
    name =
      igraph::V(
        gene_graph
      )$name,

    x =
      xy[
        ,
        1
      ],

    y =
      xy[
        ,
        2
      ]
  )

  if (
    nrow(
      mirna_nodes
    ) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      nodes %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          gene_layout,
          by =
            "name"
        )
    )
  }

  target_positions <- mirna_gene_edges %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      mirna_name =
        paste0(
          "mirna::",
          pre_miRNA
        ),

      gene_name =
        paste0(
          "gene::",
          gene
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      gene_layout %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          gene_name =
            name,

          target_x =
            x,

          target_y =
            y
        ),
      by =
        "gene_name"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      mirna_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_x =
        mean(
          target_x,
          na.rm =
            TRUE
        ),

      mean_y =
        mean(
          target_y,
          na.rm =
            TRUE
        ),

      .groups =
        "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      target_angle =
        atan2(
          mean_y,
          mean_x
        )
    )

  mirna_layout <- mirna_nodes %>%
    dplyr::select(
      name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      target_positions,
      by = c(
        "name" =
          "mirna_name"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      target_angle,
      name
    )

  angles <- seq(
    -pi,
    pi,
    length.out =
      nrow(
        mirna_layout
      ) +
      1
  )[
    seq_len(
      nrow(
        mirna_layout
      )
    )
  ]

  mirna_layout <- mirna_layout %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      x =
        params$
          mirna_radius *
        cos(
          angles
        ),

      y =
        params$
          mirna_radius *
        sin(
          angles
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      name,
      x,
      y
    )

  nodes %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        gene_layout,
        mirna_layout
      ),
      by =
        "name"
    )
}
```

```{r}
build_network <- function(
    panel_name,
    dataset_name,
    panel_title
) {
  prepared <- panel_data[[
    panel_name
  ]]

  pathway_genes <-
    prepared$
      pathway_genes

  candidate_interactions <-
    prepared$
      candidate_interactions

  
  
  
  if (
    nrow(
      candidate_interactions
    ) > 0
  ) {
    mirna_gene_edges <- candidate_interactions %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        pre_miRNA,
        gene,
        miRNA_logFC,
        miRNA_FDR,
        miRNA_Direction
      ) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        mature_miRNAs =
          safe_unique_collapse(
            mature_miRNA
          ),

        databases =
          safe_unique_collapse(
            database
          ),

        experiments =
          safe_unique_collapse(
            experiment
          ),

        support_types =
          safe_unique_collapse(
            support_type
          ),

        pubmed_ids =
          safe_unique_collapse(
            pubmed_id
          ),

        strong_experimental =
          any(
            strong_experimental,
            na.rm =
              TRUE
          ),

        strong_experiments =
          safe_unique_collapse(
            experiment[
              strong_experimental
            ]
          ),

        edge_type =
          dplyr::if_else(
            strong_experimental,
            "Strong experimental evidence",
            "Validated multiMiR"
          ),

        .groups =
          "drop"
      )

    if (
      params$
        plot_only_strong_mirna_edges
    ) {
      mirna_gene_edges <- mirna_gene_edges %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          strong_experimental
        )
    }

  } else {
    mirna_gene_edges <- tibble::tibble(
      pre_miRNA =
        character(),

      gene =
        character(),

      miRNA_logFC =
        numeric(),

      miRNA_FDR =
        numeric(),

      miRNA_Direction =
        character(),

      mature_miRNAs =
        character(),

      databases =
        character(),

      experiments =
        character(),

      support_types =
        character(),

      pubmed_ids =
        character(),

      strong_experimental =
        logical(),

      strong_experiments =
        character(),

      edge_type =
        character()
    )
  }

  supported_genes <- unique(
    mirna_gene_edges$
      gene
  )

  
  
  
  string_ids <- string_db$mp(
    as.character(
      pathway_genes$
        gene
    )
  )

  mapped <- pathway_genes %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      STRING_id =
        as.character(
          string_ids
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(
        STRING_id
      ),

      nzchar(
        STRING_id
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      STRING_id,
      .keep_all =
        TRUE
    )

  if (
    nrow(
      mapped
    ) >= 2
  ) {
    string_interactions <-
      string_db$get_interactions(
        mapped$
          STRING_id
      ) %>%
      tibble::as_tibble() %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        combined_score >=
          params$
            string_score_threshold
      )
  } else {
    string_interactions <-
      tibble::tibble(
        from =
          character(),

        to =
          character(),

        combined_score =
          numeric()
      )
  }

  string_to_gene <- mapped %>%
    dplyr::select(
      STRING_id,
      gene
    )

  
  
  
  ppi_edges <- string_interactions %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      string_to_gene %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          from_gene =
            gene
        ),

      by = c(
        "from" =
          "STRING_id"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      string_to_gene %>%
        dplyr::rename(
          to_gene =
            gene
        ),

      by = c(
        "to" =
          "STRING_id"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(
        from_gene
      ),

      !is.na(
        to_gene
      ),

      from_gene !=
        to_gene
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      from =
        paste0(
          "gene::",
          from_gene
        ),

      to =
        paste0(
          "gene::",
          to_gene
        ),

      edge_type =
        "STRING PPI",

      combined_score,

      evidence =
        paste0(
          "STRING combined score: ",
          combined_score
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      edge_a =
        pmin(
          from,
          to
        ),

      edge_b =
        pmax(
          from,
          to
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      edge_a,
      edge_b,
      .keep_all =
        TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -edge_a,
      -edge_b
    )

  
  
  
  
  
  network_mirna_edges <- mirna_gene_edges %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      from =
        paste0(
          "mirna::",
          pre_miRNA
        ),

      to =
        paste0(
          "gene::",
          gene
        ),

      edge_type,

      combined_score =
        NA_real_,

      evidence =
        paste0(
          "Mature miRNA: ",
          mature_miRNAs,
          "; database: ",
          databases,
          "; experiment: ",
          experiments,
          "; support type: ",
          support_types,
          "; PubMed: ",
          pubmed_ids,
          "; strong experimental: ",
          strong_experimental
        )
    )

  all_edges <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    ppi_edges,
    network_mirna_edges
  )

  
  
  
  gene_nodes <- pathway_genes %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      name =
        paste0(
          "gene::",
          gene
        ),

      label =
        gene,

      node_type =
        "Gene",

      Direction,

      logFC,

      FDR,

      logFC_bin =
        make_logFC_bin(
          logFC
        ),

      label_class =
        dplyr::if_else(
          gene %in%
            supported_genes,

          "miRNA-supported gene",

          "Other gene"
        )
    )


  mirna_nodes <- mirna_gene_edges %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      pre_miRNA,
      miRNA_logFC,
      miRNA_FDR,
      miRNA_Direction
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      name =
        paste0(
          "mirna::",
          pre_miRNA
        ),

      label =
        pre_miRNA,

      node_type =
        "pre-miRNA",

      Direction =
        miRNA_Direction,

      logFC =
        miRNA_logFC,

      FDR =
        miRNA_FDR,

      logFC_bin =
        make_logFC_bin(
          miRNA_logFC
        ),

      label_class =
        "Other gene"
    )


  
  
  nodes <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    gene_nodes,
    mirna_nodes
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      name,
      .keep_all =
        TRUE
    )

  nodes <- make_outer_ring_layout(
    nodes =
      nodes,

    ppi_edges =
      ppi_edges,

    mirna_gene_edges =
      mirna_gene_edges
  )

  graph_object <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    all_edges %>%
      dplyr::select(
        from,
        to,
        edge_type,
        combined_score,
        evidence
      ) %>%
      as.data.frame(),

    directed =
      FALSE,

    vertices =
      nodes %>%
      as.data.frame()
  )

  vertex_order <- igraph::V(
    graph_object
  )$name

  x <- nodes$x[
    match(
      vertex_order,
      nodes$name
    )
  ]

  y <- nodes$y[
    match(
      vertex_order,
      nodes$name
    )
  ]

  p <- ggraph::ggraph(
    graph_object,
    layout =
      "manual",
    x =
      x,
    y =
      y
  ) +

    ggraph::geom_edge_link(
      ggplot2::aes(
        edge_colour =
          edge_type,

        edge_width =
          edge_type,

        edge_alpha =
          edge_type,

        edge_linetype =
          edge_type
      )
    ) +

    ggraph::scale_edge_colour_manual(
      values =
        edge_colors,

      breaks = c(
        "STRING PPI",
        "Validated multiMiR",
        "Strong experimental evidence"
      ),

      name =
        "Interaction"
    ) +

    ggraph::scale_edge_width_manual(
      values =
        edge_widths,

      guide =
        "none"
    ) +

    ggraph::scale_edge_alpha_manual(
      values =
        edge_alphas,

      guide =
        "none"
    ) +

    ggraph::scale_edge_linetype_manual(
      values =
        edge_linetypes,

      breaks = c(
        "STRING PPI",
        "Validated multiMiR",
        "Strong experimental evidence"
      ),

      name =
        "Interaction"
    ) +

    ggraph::geom_node_point(
      ggplot2::aes(
        shape =
          node_type,

        fill =
          Direction,

        size =
          logFC_bin
      ),

      colour =
        "black",

      stroke =
        0.5
    ) +

    
    ggraph::geom_node_text(
      data =
        function(x) {
          x %>%
            dplyr::filter(
              node_type ==
                "Gene"
            )
        },

      ggplot2::aes(
        label =
          label,

        colour =
          label_class
      ),

      repel =
        FALSE,

      size =
        3,

      fontface =
        "bold",

      max.overlaps =
        Inf,

      box.padding =
        0.10,

      point.padding =
        0.08,

      segment.alpha =
        0.25
    ) +

    
    ggraph::geom_node_text(
      data =
        function(x) {
          x %>%
            dplyr::filter(
              node_type ==
                "pre-miRNA"
            )
        },

      ggplot2::aes(
        label =
          label
      ),

      repel =
        TRUE,

      colour =
        "black",

      size =
        3,

      fontface =
        "bold",

      max.overlaps =
        Inf,

      box.padding =
        0.15,

      point.padding =
        0.10,

      segment.alpha =
        0.20
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(
        "Gene" =
          21,

        "pre-miRNA" =
          22
      ),

      name =
        "Node type"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values =
        node_fill_colors,

      breaks = c(
        "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
        "Up in MSS/TMB-H"
      ),

      name =
        "Direction"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_size_manual(
      values =
        logFC_size_values,

      breaks =
        logFC_bin_levels,

      drop =
        FALSE,

      name =
        expression(
          "|log"[2] *
            " fold-change|"
        )
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values =
        label_colors,

      breaks = c(
        "Other gene",
        "miRNA-supported gene"
      ),

      name =
        "Gene label"
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title =
        panel_title,

      subtitle =
        paste0(
          nrow(
            pathway_genes
          ),
          " pathway DE+bootstrap genes; ",
          nrow(
            mirna_nodes
          ),
          " linked shared pre-miRNAs; ",
          sum(
            mirna_gene_edges$
              strong_experimental,
            na.rm =
              TRUE
          ),
          "/",
          nrow(
            mirna_gene_edges
          ),
          " miRNA-gene edges with strong experimental evidence"
        )
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_void(
      base_size =
        11
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face =
            "bold",

          hjust =
            0.5
        ),

      plot.subtitle =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          hjust =
            0.5,

          size =
            9
        ),

      legend.position =
        "bottom",

      legend.box =
        "vertical"
    )

  list(
    plot =
      p,

    nodes =
      nodes,

    edges =
      all_edges,

    pathway_genes =
      pathway_genes,

    mirna_gene_edges =
      mirna_gene_edges,

    mapped_genes =
      mapped
  )
}
```

```{r}
network_results <- list()

for (
  i in seq_len(
    nrow(
      panel_specification
    )
  )
) {
  panel <- panel_specification$
    panel[
      i
    ]

  network_results[[
    panel

      panel,

      panel_specification$

          i
        ],

    panel_title =
      panel_specification$
        title[
          i
        ]
  )

  stub <- paste0(
    panel,
    "_",
    panel_specification$
      dataset[
        i
      ],
    "_",
    panel_specification$
      pathway[
        i
      ]
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(
      individual_plot_dir,
      paste0(
        stub,
        ".svg"
      )
    ),
    network_results[[
      panel
    ]]$
      plot,
    width =
      params$
        individual_width,
    height =
      params$
        individual_height,
    device =
      "svg"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(
      individual_plot_dir,
      paste0(
        stub,
        ".pdf"
      )
    ),
    network_results[[
      panel
    ]]$
      plot,
    width =
      params$
        individual_width,
    height =
      params$
        individual_height,
    device =
      grDevices::
        cairo_pdf
  )

  write.csv(
    network_results[[
      panel
    ]]$
      nodes,
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0(
        stub,
        "_nodes.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names =
      FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    flatten_list_columns(
      network_results[[
        panel
      ]]$
        edges
    ),
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0(
        stub,
        "_edges.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names =
      FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    flatten_list_columns(
      network_results[[
        panel
      ]]$
        mirna_gene_edges
    ),
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0(
        stub,
        "_miRNA_gene_experimental_evidence.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names =
      FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
gene_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    seq_len(
      nrow(
        panel_specification
      )
    ),
    function(i) {
      panel <- panel_specification$
        panel[
          i
        ]

      selected <- panel_data[[
        panel
      ]]$
        pathway_genes$
        gene

      plotted <- network_results[[
        panel
      ]]$
        nodes %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          node_type ==
            "Gene"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(
          label
        )

      tibble::tibble(
        Panel =
          panel,

        Selected_pathway_genes =
          length(
            selected
          ),

        Plotted_gene_nodes =
          length(
            plotted
          ),

        Missing_gene_nodes =
          length(
            setdiff(
              selected,
              plotted
            )
          ),

        Missing_genes =
          paste(
            setdiff(
              selected,
              plotted
            ),
            collapse =
              "; "
          )
      )
    }
  )
)

write.csv(
  gene_audit,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "gene_node_audit.csv"
  ),
  row.names =
    FALSE
)
```

```{r}
network_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    seq_len(
      nrow(
        panel_specification
      )
    ),
    function(i) {
      panel <- panel_specification$
        panel[
          i
        ]

      x <- network_results[[
        panel
      ]]

      tibble::tibble(
        Panel =
          panel,

        Dataset =
          panel_specification$
            dataset[
              i
            ],

        Pathway =
          panel_specification$
            pathway[
              i
            ],

        Pathway_DE_bootstrap_genes =
          nrow(
            x$
              pathway_genes
          ),

        STRING_mapped_genes =
          nrow(
            x$
              mapped_genes
          ),

        Shared_pre_miRNAs_total =
          nrow(
            shared_mirna
          ),

        Shared_pre_miRNAs_linked_to_pathway =
          dplyr::n_distinct(
            x$
              mirna_gene_edges$
              pre_miRNA
          ),

        miRNA_supported_pathway_genes =
          dplyr::n_distinct(
            x$
              mirna_gene_edges$
              gene
          ),

        Validated_multiMiR_edges =
          nrow(
            x$
              mirna_gene_edges
          ),

        Strong_experimental_edges =
          sum(
            x$
              mirna_gene_edges$
              strong_experimental,
            na.rm =
              TRUE
          )
      )
    }
  )
)

write.csv(
  network_summary,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "network_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names =
    FALSE
)
```

```{r}
workbook <- list(
  Shared_pre_miRNAs =
    shared_mirna,

  Shared_pre_miRNA_summary =
    shared_mirna_summary,

  Mature_candidates =
    shared_mature_candidates,

  Experimental_evidence_audit =
    evidence_audit,

  Strong_assay_summary =
    strong_assay_summary,

  Panel_audit =
    panel_audit,

  Gene_audit =
    gene_audit,

  Network_summary =
    network_summary
)

for (
  panel in c(
    "A",
    "B",
    "C",
    "D",
    "E",
    "F"
  )
) {
  workbook[[
    paste0(
      panel,
      "_nodes"
    )
  ]] <-
    network_results[[
      panel
    ]]$
      nodes

  workbook[[
    paste0(
      panel,
      "_edges"
    )
  ]] <-
    flatten_list_columns(
      network_results[[
        panel
      ]]$
        edges
    )

  workbook[[
    paste0(
      panel,
      "_miRNA_gene"
    )
  ]] <-
    flatten_list_columns(
      network_results[[
        panel
      ]]$
        mirna_gene_edges
    )
}

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  workbook,
  file =
    file.path(
      params$output_root,
      "STRING_shared_pre_miRNA_strong_multiMiR_styled_networks.xlsx"
    ),
  overwrite =
    TRUE
)
```
